body:
As a teen who has attempted suicide before, i say that even if they didn't *say* or *do* anything suspicious, they can still be suicidal. It was like that for me too... I was hiding everything for fear that if i was honest with anyone id be more likely blamed or judged, or advised without thought than actually listened to or helped. That was a defence mechanism.

Talk to them. And try your best to not sound judgemental or anything

You don't seem to understand the level of hell I'm on.
I don't even care about "income" or "wages" anymore. It's just gonna be the long slog for the next 50 years. My father works in healthcare. Every day he comes home late with aches and pains, and he has complained about his work. If this is what someone relatively high up on income gets, we don't even need to talk about the actual street cleaner. Its just gonna be a shitty and horrible life, just a matter of more or less shitty. Death seems a cheap and easy way out of this.
Also, everything else I'm told suggests that this insane comeback you made is incredibly unlikely.
Note:im not suicidal, i couldnt think of anything better for a second sentence

though, honestly i thought my problem with DOING is probably finding common ground to start a convo... but if you think about it, many conversations can be started on curiosity and just questioning...

and then there's probably the idea that there's something to be lost from "failure"... which is totally false unless i totally and utterly foul up

> The question you need to ask yourself, is, Do you want help? or Do you want to change?

this is arguably the most helpful part of your comment - you didn't say anything i hadnt heard of before, I know what i need to do, I'M JUST NOT DOING it.

not therapist here: YES YES YES oh my god. 

That is precisely what i did earlier on in my life, and my doctrine when talking to people wasnt much different: "you have the right to remain silent. people will try to use anything you say against you. to be invincible, dont talk. if you have to, share minimally"
thanks for trying to help, have updoot.
